hero.title: Climate‑smart farming for food security
hero.subtitle: Building resilient livelihoods through conservation agriculture on the Foundations for Farming model.

challenge.heading: The Challenge
challenge.text: Smallholder households face low and unreliable yields, degraded soils, erratic rainfall and high post-harvest losses, leaving them food-insecure and dependent on negative coping during hunger gaps. EFSS promotes conservation agriculture and climate-smart practices to raise and stabilise production and build resilience.

items.title: Farmer field groups & lead farmers
items.description: Organise and train farmer groups, using a lead‑farmer model and demonstration plots for practical, farmer‑to‑farmer learning.

items.title: Conservation & climate‑smart practices
items.description: Promote minimum soil disturbance, soil cover, crop rotation/association, and moisture‑ and soil‑fertility management suited to local conditions.

items.title: Inputs & market links
items.description: Improve access to appropriate seed and basic tools, and connect farmers to input suppliers and markets.

items.title: Post‑harvest & food availability
items.description: Support better storage and handling to cut losses and extend food availability.

items.title: Inclusion
items.description: Ensure women farmers and youth participate fully and benefit equitably.

currentWork.heading: What We Are Doing Now
items: Training 129 smallholder farmers (54 prior year + 75 this year) in Biliny, Bajur, Dumandong, and Jerusal Church, Mangala Payam.
Operating a 50×100 m demonstration farm in Gumbo‑Sherikat (Juba 2) showcasing Foundations for Farming techniques.
21‑person field team (National Champions & interns) delivering hands‑on training and follow‑up support.
Harvested 472.44 kg of maize from 0.132 ha – clear proof that climate‑smart farming works.
Produced 632.97 kg of assorted vegetables and groundnuts using sack and bed methods on 0.01865 ha.

items.title: Juba Demonstration Farm
items.description: A 50×100 m training site in Gumbo‑Sherikat (Juba 2) showcasing conservation agriculture practices and hosting farmer field days.

items.description: Mobile training delivered in Biliny, Bajur, Dumandong, and Jerusal Church (Mangala Payam), reaching 129 farmers with hands‑on conservation agriculture.
